title: Our Future Health — Participant geographies data — Country and region — warning checks
description: Non-blocking checks for the country_region table, from rules the source does not state but the steward accepted (D129). A finding is a warning for analysts and data providers: it never rejects a row and never changes data. Run tools/warn.py; the main schema and tools/validate.py are unaffected.
